_doc: The other chasers (story 7.4, services/grownupLogic.js, entities/Grownups.js). Each has a cause (an event), walks at `speed` px/s straight at the nearest kid (sliding along walls) and can be escaped: hidden for `hideSeconds` or farther than `loseDistance` px for `loseSeconds` ends it. A catch costs `lossCents` (never more than the family has) and a kind scolding, never more; afterwards, and after losing the kids, he walks off for `calmSeconds` and is gone for `cooldown` seconds. janitor (Hausmeister): chases kids who run onto the school yard behind the school. inspector: boards after a tram ride without a ticket (the fine itself was paid on the tram). dog: the neighbor dog joins when the neighbor storms out of his door (neighbor:alert); it only trots after the kids and calms down after `chaseSeconds` or when they are `loseDistance` px away (data/dogs.json animal rules, entities/NeighborDogs.js). The neighbor himself is the ding-dong-run chaser of story 6.2 (data/neighbors.json). Texts: grownup.<id>.shout / caught / calm.
